title: Autonomous conformer thermochemistry of isolated cationic thiourea
difficulty_reasons: The three scientific objects and endpoint are fixed; the main burden is a defensible calculation, validation and transparent reporting rather than candidate discovery.

data.description: Three explicit XYZ starting geometries for 7+ conformers, charge +1 singlet.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-conformer thermochemistry, relative energies, ordering, method and conclusion.
